description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pestbrood Sloth, adding {C}{C}.
When Pestbrood Sloth dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Pestbrood Sloth trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Pestbrood Sloth from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
